description: This script generates C++ header and test files for Google Test predicate assertions based on a maximum arity parameter. It automates the creation of macro implementations and associated unit tests for predicate functions and functors.

methods.name: HeaderPreamble
methods.description: Generates the preamble string for the header file, including copyright, license, and macro definitions.

methods.name: ImplementationForArity
methods.description: Creates the implementation code for predicate assertions of a specific arity.

methods.name: HeaderPostamble
methods.description: Provides the closing code for the header file.

methods.name: GenerateFile
methods.description: Writes content to a specified file, overwriting existing content.

methods.name: GenerateHeader
methods.description: Generates the complete header file with predicate macros up to a specified maximum arity.

methods.name: UnitTestPreamble
methods.description: Creates the preamble string for the unit test file, including license and setup code.

methods.name: TestsForArity
methods.description: Generates the unit tests for predicate assertions of a specific arity.

methods.name: UnitTestPostamble
methods.description: Provides the closing code for the unit test file.

methods.name: GenerateUnitTest
methods.description: Creates the complete unit test file for predicate assertions up to a specified maximum arity.

methods.name: _Main
methods.description: Main entry point that processes command line argument for maximum arity and triggers header and test generation.
